notes: Quotes are YouTube auto-caption text, verbatim; misheard names are corrected in [brackets]. Every quote was matched word-for-word against the caption track, and t_seconds is the start of its first word.

Evidence kind 'did' cites a decision record (data/roffle/decisions.jsonl or brRkg1_VFAU.decisions.jsonl) or an aggregate over them; 'said' is commentary only. basis: does = seen in the decision logs, says = only said, does+says = both.
ante on evidence is read from the HUD by OCR (approximate; older reads sometimes show ante 4 as 5).

Decks were read from the deck-back sprite in the videos (Ghost = Enhancers atlas 6,2; Checkered = 1,3). Stakes come from the video descriptions, plus the white stake chip and his own remark in the naneinf videos.

sources.title: Just. Play. Pairs. (Gold Stake Lessons)
sources.result: won the seeded run (seed JNM9VD6W) at Gold stake
sources.summary: Checkered deck makes flushes easy, but that doesn't mean you should play them. Use the free flushes for the first rounds without opening Buffoon packs, find a chips joker (Square Joker), then play Pairs and fill the deck with value cards. Play conservatively early, because lost money compounds through interest.

principles.statement: In antes 1–2 put money into jokers that score now or make money, then from ante 3 leave every shop with at least $25 so interest stays capped.
principles.why: Early money is worth more as a joker that keeps the run alive. Once the board clears blinds, the $5 a round of capped interest is his steadiest income, and he only dips below it for a core piece. BalatroUniversity adds that when the deck already scores (Checkered), you should spend nothing early.

evidence.action: Money on leaving the shop, HUD OCR, 6 analysed Gold-stake runs (the debt run OTn6yl2jxGg left out): antes 1–2 median $21 but split, with 47% of exits under $10 (poor starts) and 42% at $25+ (when early money jokers paid); antes 3–4 median $38, 71% at $25+; antes 5–8 median $40, 79%; ante 9+ median $54.5, 93% (n = 19, 21, 89, 27 shop visits).

evidence.quote: The important thing is we got to an interest breakpoint.
I think I want the money more than I need some scaling right now.
best to play as conservatively as possible in the early game. That gives you the money. That gives you the resources to
